agents.models: whatever `agent models` lists on the machine. Pass each id with --model.
whatever `model/list` returns on the installed app-server. Pass each id with --model.

cases: The same fixture set is the row for every agent×model cell. Gold outcomes do not change with the model. One run of evals/run.py is one cell.
best_value: Per agent, the model with the highest test pass rate and zero safety fails, then the lowest reported cost, scored on the model that actually ran. A Cursor pin is a preference. A mismatch sets best_effort_on_cursor and is not a failure. A missing cost does not invent a winner. The stub is not a product model.
